evidence.detail: css_url() appends ?v=<git-commit-hash-of-css-file> to bust cache on each deploy; the hash is cached in-memory per Flask worker process.
HTML pages use Cache-Control: no-cache, public, max-age=3600, meaning the browser must revalidate with the server each time before using the cached page.
Server-side cache is bypassed only when the browser sends Cache-Control: no-cache (hard refresh); Safari does not send this header on hard refresh per in-code comment.
No nginx config or CDN configuration found in the repo; cannot determine whether a proxy strips or ignores query-string cache busters upstream.

triage.notes: The symptom (stale CSS fixed by Ctrl+Shift+Refresh) is consistent with either a CDN/proxy that ignores query-string cache busters, or a browser service worker. Cannot confirm root cause without server logs or a running environment. The in-code comment about Safari also suggests some known caching edge-cases exist.
